answer: Capacity-bounded max-flow scoring deters Sybils so clones cannot spread on a whisper of free keys. Agents sign capped vouches, forming a graph branching like juniper from trusted seeds, and verifiers admit nodes whose edge-disjoint paths from seeds meet a flow threshold. Because honest cuts bound total flow, attackers must earn verifiable endorsements, scarce as an opal, per identity. Still, compromised seeds can validate collusion rings, while unvouched newcomers face exclusion.
